name: Pot
overview: Scripture admonishes believers to live honorably and avoid behaviors associated with excess and impurity, such as drunkenness and immoral acts, which can be connected to the misuse of substances like pot. Romans 13:13 urges walking honestly and decently, steering clear of rioting and drunkenness, while Ephesians 5:18 contrasts drunkenness with being filled with the Spirit. Galatians 5:19 highlights works of the flesh including uncleanness and lasciviousness, reinforcing the call to holiness and self-control in all areas of life.
